protocol.instruction: Confirm each parking space physically and assign a subarea and availability classification.
Record occupied, free, inaccessible and disputed spaces.
Record mosque attendance or a traceable proxy for each measurement.
Record significant simultaneous use by surrounding facilities.
Attach time-stamped photographs and a signed count sheet.
Verify whether every counted space is public, private or subject to restrictions.
Calculate occupancy by subarea and total without treating the provisional 300-space hypothesis as proven.

warning: The 300-space figure is a provisional field hypothesis.
